semantics: return a copy of the std::string at +0x10 (checksum_): length 0 -> empty; length 1 -> one byte; lengths 2..15 -> SSO memcpy; length > 15 -> _M_create + memcpy; NUL terminator after the last byte

abi.return: std::string by value (hidden return-storage pointer in rdi, this in rsi)
abi.evidence: mov %rdi,(%rbx) stores rdi+0x10 into the storage object (would clobber the vptr if rdi were this); length/pointer read from [rsi+0x18]/[rsi+0x10], i.e. this+0x18/+0x10; rax returns the storage pointer

heap_alloc_call.args: this = out, capacity slot on the stack, old capacity 0

memcpy_call.args: dst = out buffer, src = [rsi+0x10], n = length

empty.note: length 0 stores an empty string (NUL at the SSO buffer)

one_byte.note: length 1 copies a single byte, then the NUL terminator

sso_max_15.note: length 15 is the longest SSO copy (no allocation)

heap_min_16.note: length 16 takes the _M_create + memcpy heap path

finalize_output_round_trip.note: the Finalize output (BE32 of 0xe3069283) copies back unchanged

name_round_trip.note: the 18-byte generator name (heap path) copies back unchanged

long_source_1024_ab.note: only the copied bytes differ from nothing; the copy is exact

end_to_end_update_finalize_get.note: Update accumulates extend(0, data) = 0xe3069283; Finalize appends its big-endian form; GetChecksum returns those same 4 bytes
